items.name: latex
items.description: A LaTeX formula drawn as glyph paths, morphing token by token between formulas.

items.name: latex-matrix
items.description: A matrix typeset from its entries, each one addressable as a part.

items.name: number-line
items.description: One axis with ticks and numbers; children sit at a value along it.

items.name: axes2d
items.description: An x and a y axis whose children sit in graph coordinates.

items.name: number-plane
items.description: Axes over a full grid with square units.

items.name: function-plot
items.description: The curve of an equation: a function, a polar or a parametric one.

items.name: points-plot
items.description: A line or closed shape through listed graph points.

items.name: plot-point
items.description: A labelled dot at graph coordinates, or riding a plot.

items.name: vector-arrow
items.description: An arrow between two graph points.

items.name: curve-area
items.description: The region under a plot or between two.

items.name: riemann-sum
items.description: Rectangles approximating the area under a plot.

items.name: tangent-line
items.description: The tangent or a secant to a plot.

items.name: drop-lines
items.description: Guide lines from a graph point to the axes.

items.name: curly-brace
items.description: A curly brace along a node, a part of a formula, or two points.

items.name: angle-mark
items.description: The arc or square of an angle, with its label.

items.name: emphasis-mark
items.description: A box, circle, underline or cross drawn on a node or a part of a formula.

items.name: axes3d
items.description: A 3D graph with its own camera: three axes through a box of graph coordinates, z up, whose children sit in graph units.

items.name: surface-plot3d
items.description: A surface in a 3D graph: a height over x and y, or three parts in u and v.

items.name: curve-plot3d
items.description: A curve through a 3D graph, three parts in t, drawn as a tube.

items.name: plot-point3d
items.description: A labelled dot at 3D graph coordinates, riding a surface it is put inside.

items.name: vector-arrow3d
items.description: An arrow between two points of a 3D graph.

items.name: polar-plane
items.description: Rings and spokes about an origin, whose children sit in graph coordinates.

items.name: vector-field
items.description: A grid of arrows showing a vector field, coloured by its strength.

items.name: stream-lines
items.description: The lines a vector field carries a point along, which can be sent flowing.

items.name: traced-path
items.description: The trail a point leaves as a value changes.

items.name: network-graph
items.description: Vertices and edges arranged in a circle, by springs, as a tree or in a grid.

items.name: sample-space
items.description: A probability's whole cut into parts whose areas are their probabilities.
